patch.value: Cross-harness provenance adapters: automatically resolve native model, version, and effort signals beyond Claude without identity flags

The bounded non-environment resolver shipped for Claude session JSONL and AI_AGENT_VERSION, but fresh Codex mutations on 2026-08-03 still record model null and effort null. The built-in registry covers seven harness names while live non-null provenance is effectively harness-specific. Build a public SDK adapter contract and privacy-reviewed built-in adapters for Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor, Aider, and Gemini CLI. Each adapter declares its native sources, supported dimensions, bounded probe policy, normalization vocabulary, version, confidence, and explicit unavailable or failed outcomes. Packages may register adapters without patching CLI code. No agent supplies PM_AUTHOR or repeats model or thinking-level flags.

A versioned public SDK adapter interface declares harness detection, native sources, supported dimensions, bounded probe limits, normalization, source attribution, and explicit outcome categories; Built-in adapters cover Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor, Aider, and Gemini CLI; each adapter has a redacted real boundary fixture or a documented no-signal waiver; A live Codex mutation records the actual model family and reasoning effort available to the harness, without PM_AUTHOR, author, model, or effort flags; if the platform exposes neither, the exact unavailable source is observable rather than silently null; Probe implementations read only allow-listed metadata fields under byte and time ceilings, fail closed, never block a mutation, never retain arbitrary session text or host paths, and can be disabled by policy; CLI, SDK, MCP, extension, nested-process, npx, and bunx paths share the same adapter result and immutable source attribution; Packages can add or override a harness adapter through the SDK registry with schema validation, priority rules, collision diagnostics, and no CLI source change; Corpus coverage reports success, unavailable, failed, and undeclared rates per harness and dimension; a negative control proves CI fails when a declared live adapter remains inert; Normalization preserves raw provider identifiers only when policy permits and always emits a stable model-family and effort vocabulary suitable for longitudinal analytics
Record trustworthy harness, model, version, and reasoning-effort provenance automatically across the supported agent fleet
Attribution and quality analytics become comparable across harnesses instead of being accurate only for the first implemented adapter
Enables model-aware context, cost, throughput, evaluation, and defect-escape analysis while eliminating manual author configuration
Every supported harness either records its native identity dimensions with an attributable source or a precise, observable unavailable or failed reason
The current Codex session is correctly detected as a harness and unique instance, yet all four provenance dimensions are null; the closed Claude probe does not satisfy the cross-harness mandate

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Live confirmation on this repository 2026-08-03, read from the raw history entry of a Claude Code mutation made with no identity flags and no environment override.

The recorded provenance is now: author harness:claude-code with author_source detected, agent_harness claude-code, agent_model claude-opus-5 with agent_model_source probe, model source probe, effort xhigh from environment, version 2.1.220 from probe, and a stable agent_instance.

Three of the five dimensions the mandate asks for are therefore live and automatic for this harness: harness, model, and reasoning effort. Against the long-standing baseline of model null on every one of tens of thousands of entries, that is the dimension crossing from never-observed to observed, and it did so through the non-environment resolver rather than through more environment keys, which is the design decision this item generalizes.

The two dimensions still missing on the same entry are exactly the two this item and its siblings own. role records the string 1, which is a boolean environment flag rendered as a value. topic is null. Neither is a regression and neither is fixed by another Claude-side key, which is why the adapter contract and the semantic inference layer remain the right shape for the remaining work.

The concrete consequence for this item is that the Claude adapter now has a working reference implementation for the model and version dimensions, so the other six built-in adapters have a template and a fixture shape to conform to rather than a specification alone.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Fresh Codex evidence 2026-08-04 with no PM_AUTHOR or --author: the plan mutation history records author=harness:codex, author_source=detected, agent_harness=codex, and a stable agent_instance, so zero-flag harness detection works. The same raw event has no agent_model, effort, role, or topic fields, so model/version/thinking-level and semantic session attribution remain incomplete for Codex. The external-package fleet smoke script also explicitly sets PM_AUTHOR=external-package-smoke and passes --author during init, masking whether package workflows honor automatic identity. Remove that test crutch only as part of this canonical cross-harness contract, with fixtures that prove all dimensions.

value.text: Fresh Codex Desktop evidence 2026-08-14 with no PM_AUTHOR or identity flags: mutation pm-zzylb9 records author=harness:codex, author_source=detected, harness=codex, stable instance, inferred role=implementer, and inferred topic=pm-a8zm. Model and effort remain explicitly null, so the canonical adapter requirement is narrower than the 2026-08-04 snapshot but still open: resolve the actual Codex model family/version and reasoning level when the platform exposes them, otherwise persist an observable unavailable source instead of a silent null.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Live automatic-provenance census 2026-08-15: the most recent 7,330 immutable events all record agent_harness; 7,328 also record instance/provenance without PM_AUTHOR or --author. Harness mix is 6,260 Codex and 1,070 Claude Code. Across the full corpus, 916 model observations exist and all are claude-opus-5; current Codex events still record model and thinking effort as null even though author, harness, instance, and bounded role/topic evidence are available. The remaining contract is therefore precise: retain zero-flag automatic attribution, add privacy-safe Codex/OpenCode/Pi/Cursor/Aider/Gemini adapters through the SDK registry, distinguish unavailable from failed detection, and conformance-test CLI/MCP/npx/bunx parity without inventing model or effort values.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Fresh zero-flag provenance evidence 2026-08-22: this task's claim event records author=harness:codex, author_source=detected, agent_harness=codex, a stable privacy-safe instance, inferred role=implementer, and a bounded workset topic spanning the claimed canonical items. Model and effort remain null. The item-level provenance summary resolves the harness on 7/7 entries but observes model and effort on only 1/7, confirming that automatic author/harness/session-role detection works while the Codex native model and thinking-level adapter remains the precise open gap. No PM_AUTHOR or --author was supplied.
